Game Scenes

How to Play

1
Base Game & Nudge — Bathala 1000 is played on a 3×3 grid with 5 fixed paylines. When an Ex Nudge Wild lands during a winning spin, the Special Reel nudges and collects each multiplier it passes. The combined multiplier is then applied to every win from that spin.
2
Three Gem Effects — Blue Gems split symbols and multiply their values, Purple Gems add an Ex Nudge Wild and can multiply the number of nudges, while Green Gems turn every symbol on up to 3 selected reels into Wilds.
3
Bathala’s Blessing — Bathala may enhance the result by upgrading the Special Reel multiplier, replacing it with a higher multiplier or Ex Nudge, or respinning a reel to guarantee a stronger win.
4
Extra Bet — Pay 50% more per spin to remove lower multipliers from the Special Reel, increase the chance of landing higher multipliers, and unlock Ex Nudge results of up to 1,000 nudges.
